title: license-policy.yaml — derived borrow-compatibility policy
description: Contract for the S1.2 override surface (road-to-provenance-and-license-governance). `policy.{allow,conditional,deny}` are the closed compatibility-matrix source classes; the top-level `deny` array is a flattened, concrete-SPDX-id view of `policy.deny` — it is the shape `src/scripts/lint_provenance.ts`'s `resolveDenyPolicy()` already reads directly, so this file works as its override surface without any change on that side. `derived_from: manual` marks the file as a consumer override the detector must never silently overwrite (loosening any class below the derived verdict is rejected unless this is set). Enforced by the hand-rolled Draft-07 subset validator in validate_frontmatter.ts (`validate()`/`load_schema()`) — keep to its supported keyword set: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, pattern, minLength, maxLength, enum. No oneOf/const/patternProperties.

derived_from.description: The SPDX id the policy was derived from; 'none-detected' when no license source resolved; 'manual' when a consumer authored this file directly (never auto-overwritten, and the only value allowed to loosen policy below the derived verdict).

license_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the detected LICENSE/LICENSE.md/COPYING file content; null when no such file exists. A later change to that file's content changes this hash, which is the invalidation trigger (re-derive on mismatch, escalate on downgrade).

workspace_scope.description: 'single' when the repo declares no workspaces; 'homogeneous-multi' when workspaces are declared and none diverge from the root SPDX id. A divergent workspace escalates instead of writing this file at all (v1 scope-limiter — full per-workspace derivation is parked, see agents/roadmaps/later/road-to-per-workspace-license-policy.md).

policy.description: The closed compatibility-matrix verdict, keyed by SOURCE license class (not concrete SPDX id) — this is the roadmap S1.2 matrix output. The three arrays repeat the same item schema inline (not $ref — the hand-rolled Draft-07 subset validator this file is checked against does not resolve $ref).

deny.description: Flattened concrete-SPDX-id expansion of policy.deny — the shape lint_provenance.ts's resolveDenyPolicy() reads directly (top-level `deny: [<SPDX id>, ...]`). Never hand-edit; loosening this array without derived_from: manual is rejected by the merge step.
